_note: size_m = [width (X), height, depth] in metres, Godot axis order (Blender X, Z, Y). collision = footprint seen from above (circle radius_m = the station's FOOT), null = no blocking footprint. Front faces Blender -Y (Godot +Z). Origin on the ground at the footprint centre unless origin says otherwise (fishing_rod: at the grip). Parts and markers are child nodes of the prop root (Props.find_part).

props.name: guardian_stone
props.notes: Old leaning standing stone in flat grey patches with a moss cap, two roots coiling round the base, small white flowers, a fern, a ring of flat stones on a moss patch. The mossy hollow (dented, mossy -X face with a moss cushion on the ground) is where the Moss Warden sits (stone + (-1.1, 0, 0)). The carved leaf rune on the flat front face (-Y) is three separate gold leaves: rune_1 the centre leaf and stem, rune_2 the left leaf, rune_3 the right leaf; show rune_1..rune_<stone level>. Parts are children of the root, origin at each leaf's middle. marker_ring 1.1 m in front (-Y).

props.name: garden_bed
props.notes: Raised bed: plank walls between log corner posts, dark soil, 6 flat-topped mounds in 2 rows of 3, 0.6 m apart. marker_plot_1..3 = the front row (-Y, nearest the ring), 4..6 the back row, each left to right (-X to +X), on the mound tops (0.46 m flat tops: soil_wet and the plants sit there); markers have no rotation. Rain barrel at the back-left corner, seed crate at the back-right corner, watering can at the right end, tiny leaf sign on the front-left post. marker_ring 1.2 m in front (-Y). In the camp the bed is turned PI, so the game camera sees its back (+Y) side.

props.name: plot_weeds

props.name: fishing_spot
props.notes: Mossy stump seat, bait tin with a worm, wicker fish basket, and a rod rack (a forked rest stick and a butt peg) holding the rod, which points out over the water (+Y, Godot -Z) and up. `rod` is a separate child object with its origin at the grip (hide it while the cat has the rod). marker_tip = the rack rod's tip (start of the line when the cat cannot hold the rod). The cat stands on the +X side, which is kept clear; the water is behind (+Y).
